top30.title: Foundation models unlock robust phenotypic representations from Cell Painting images
top30.abstract: Nature Methods, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03271-yWe pretrained and systematically benchmarked a suite of self-supervised foundation models on the largest public Cell Painting dataset, enabling robust morphological feature extraction directly from multichannel high-content images without cell segmentation or feature engineering.
